race.title: Somersby Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Bumper/hurdles winner SPANISH DARLING didn't look out of place when fourth pitched into a Grade 2 on just his second hurdles start at Cheltenham 3 weeks ago, within a length of the lead prior to fluffing his lines at the last. Firmly remaining with his best days ahead of him, he's impossible to oppose returned to much calmer waters. Bumper winner Port Isaac and newcomers Made For Mary and Montevallo may emerge next best. SPANISH DARLING (FR) PORT ISAAC MADE FOR MARY (IRE)
